summary: Specifies a profile for using RTP and its control protocol, RTCP, in audio and video conferences with minimal session control. It sets default choices such as how payload types are assigned. It was replaced by RFC 3551.

eli5.summary: A video call needs agreed-upon names for each kind of sound and picture. This note is the shared list that everyone in a casual meeting uses, so their programs understand each other.

questions: what is the rtp audio video profile
how are rtp payload types defined
